scenario: Second app-server while the first app-server runs an active turn

observations.threadRead: The thread and its in-progress turn are readable from disk, but the second server reports the thread as notLoaded.
observations.threadResume: Failed: thread ... already has an active writer
observations.turnSteer: Failed: thread not found (not loaded in this server)

desktop.process: codex.exe app-server --analytics-default-enabled (no --listen; private stdio pipe owned by Codex Desktop)
desktop.sharedManagedDaemonThreadList: Desktop threads are listed from disk with status notLoaded

conclusion: Cross-process steering is blocked by the thread writer lock. Codex Desktop's app-server has no externally reachable endpoint, so HS cannot obtain both the connection and the active turn identity.
